limitations: No local Gradle or emulator execution; Android verification came from GitHub Actions.
Editor recreation is covered by repeated opening on the retained ViewModel; unsaved/failed/in-flight-save rotation was not manually exercised on a physical device.
Spoken TalkBack output was not manually tested; editable-node names and duplicate-label absence are asserted in instrumentation.

Landscape uses both physical emulator rotations and injected side insets: API 35 adds cutouts; API 26 tests side bars because typed synthetic cutout insets are unsupported. Hardware/OEM cutouts were not exercised.

Abrupt process termination, real signed APK download/install, OEM installers and unknown-app permission return were not tested on hardware. JVM file fixtures cover orphan cleanup, verification and rename; UI captures are deterministic fixtures.

R9.behavior: The activity starts without global FLAG_SECURE. AuthRoot enables protection only for unauthenticated LOGIN/REGISTER/RECOVER and unacknowledged recovery-code display. PasswordDialog enables the activity flag and explicitly sets SecureFlagPolicy.SecureOn for its separate dialog window. DisposableEffect clears on disable and on sensitive-screen disposal. Recovery-code sensitive clipboard handling is unchanged.

tests.coverage: Real AuthRoot/ProductRoot flow in dark mode: SET on login, recovery, registration, recovery-code display and change password; CLEAR on restaurant list after acknowledgement and after fresh login, restaurant editor/detail, ordinary settings and after successful password change.

Real SettingsScreen/RecordListScreen in light and dark themes: initial restaurant list CLEAR, settings CLEAR, password dialog SET, dismissal CLEAR, then restaurant list CLEAR. Reopen/dismiss twice in each theme to catch stale flags.

R9.assertion: Read activity.window.attributes.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE on the activity UI thread; assert equality to FLAG_SECURE for sensitive screens and 0 for normal screens.
